Ideas 1 and 2 are the owner's own words (idea 2 with the time word taken out). problems.words: Many people ask the price in DM every day and after I tell the price there is no reply. Roz bohat log DM mein price poochte hain, price batane ke baad reply nahi aata
quick_ideas: Send a clear photo, the size chart and a line about delivery together with the rate, so they need not ask again.
Message the people who asked the rate and went quiet with a short note on the most liked pair, so the talk starts again.

workzap_build.text: a reply with photo, size chart and delivery in one message, plus a gentle follow-up for people who went quiet and agreed to hear from you.

problems.ask_first: Do they go quiet right after you tell the price?
problems.free_stops: How the reply and the follow-up are set up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Add one line saying what the rate includes, so people do not leave over a number alone.
Look at the enquiries that did turn into orders and copy what those replies had in common, so the next reply starts from what worked.

problems.words: A large stock of unsold sets lying in the warehouse and outlets that must be sold off. Bohat stock warehouse aur outlets mein parha hai jo bechna hai, poore sets bik nahi rahe
quick_ideas: Offer past buyers a first look at the unsold sets in a private chat with photos and one clear rate, so they get first pick.
Show each ready set in a short video with the fabric close up, so viewers can judge it without asking.

workzap_build.text: a message to past buyers with photos of the unsold sets and one clear rate, sent only to people who agreed to hear from you.

problems.ask_first: Are the sets unsold in the outlets, the warehouse, or both?
problems.free_stops: How the messages and the bulk list are set up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Display the slow sets at the front of the outlet with the most walk-ins, so more shoppers see them.
Send a simple photo list of the sets to bulk buyers and nearby shops, so a large part of the stock can move in one deal.
